content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial permits a formal appeal, while retroactive authorization is unavailable because the 30-day window has closed and this payer offers no peer-to-peer review. The codes and COB order are valid, and submission with records has already failed, so another submission would not address the missing authorization. A medical-necessity appeal is the available route to seek payer reconsideration before determining any contractual patient responsibility.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
